title: June 27th: Guardians Night at the Ballpark Game
description: Let's join to cheer on the Cleveland Guardians vs Seattle Mariners. 7:10pm First pitch. Tanner Bibee City Connect Jersey give away.
imageAlt: Baseball match game flyer - Made with PosterMyWall

title: Delta Chi International Convention Craft Beer Tour
description: As the Brothers from the Northeast Ohio Alumni Chapter gather in Indy for the International Convention the Chapter will again be hosting it's Convention Craft Beer tour on Friday July 24th afternoon. Stay turned for details and pricing.

title: September 16th: Ray's Happy Hour
description: As fall starts to set in. Join the Brothers as we head to the famous Ray's Place in Kent, OH for our back to school annual Happy Hour

title: October 10th: Delta Chi Northeast Ohio Alumni Chapter 10th Anniversary Dinner
description: This Founders' Day marks the 10th Anniversary for the Northeast Ohio Alumni Chapter. Join us as we celebrate all the years of fun and success of the Alumni Chapter over the years.

title: October 13th: Founders' Day Traditions with Kent State
description: As we celebrate the Fraternity's Founders' Day. Members of the Chapter will travel to the Kent State Chapter to partake in the Chapter Traditions.

title: December 9th: Holiday Get Together
description: The Holiday season is always a time to gather with friends and family. The Northeast Ohio Chapter will be gathering for our annual Holiday Get Together again this Holiday season.

title: May 28th Meet and Greet Happy Hour
description: This May the Chapter hosted a happy hour to welcome new Brothers form the area to come out and see what the Chapter was about. We had the pleasure of reconnecting with a Case Western Alumnus, along with meeting two recent grads from the Ohio State Chapter. We hope to continue to see them along with more of the Northeast Ohio Alumni

title: Dec. 17th Holiday Get Together
description: The Chapter celebrated the holiday season again with our annual Holiday Get Together. Brothers participated in a white elephant gift exchange, while hanging out with undregrads from the Kent State Chapter along with Brothers from around the area.

title: Oct. 13th 2025 Founders' Day Dinner
description: We has a wonderful Founder's Day Dinner with the Kent State Chapter undergrads. We elected our new officers and partake in the Kent State Founders Day Traditions. Painted the rock and enjoyed everyone's company.

title: Sept. 17th 2025 Ray's Place Happy Hour
description: On Sept. 17th, 2025 The Alumni Chapter headed down to Ray's in Kent OH for our 3rd annual Ray's Happy hour to help support the Kent State Chapter Recruitment. We got to meet with the Chapter, enjoy conversations with Actives, AMs and Potential New Members and enjoy the company of all the local Alumni.

title: Aug. 9th Cleveland Whiskey Distillery Tour
description: The Brothers got to experience a private tour of the distillery, while learning both the history of the company and newer historic building the company had moved into, we got to taste 4 amazing whiskey samplings. After the tour we were able to continue taste other amazing whiskeys. The event was fun and educational.

title: July 23rd Christmas in July Happy Hour
description: It's time for our annual Christmas in July Happy Hour. The Brothers returned to the Wild Eagle Saloon for a night of food, fun and Brotherhood.

title: May 27th Guardians vs Dodgers Night at the Ballpark
description: The Brothers meet at the ballpark and watched the game from the Terrace Garden area. Though the Guardians didn't bring home a winner the Brothers enjoyed the game and the brotherhood.

title: May 15th 2025 Children's Hunger Alliance Charity Event
description: On May 15th the Brothers once again joined the Children's Hunger Alliance's side by side charity dinner. Brothers supported CHA by attending the event. When enjoying dinner the Brothers listened to all the great support the CHA does for hunger children in the Cleveland Area.

title: April 16th Bowling Kent Lanes
description: On April 2025 the Alumni Chapter joined the Kent State Undergrads for a night of Bowling and the Kent Lanes.

title: March 1st 2025 Kent State 35th/5th Anniversary
description: On March 1st 2025 the Alumni Chapter had the pleasure of attending the Kent State Chapter 35th Anniversary event in Kent, Ohio. Our Chapter is proud to continue to support the local Chapters and be apart of this milestone event.

title: Feb 1st 2025 Go Karting and Axe Throwing
description: On Feb 1st 2025 the Alumni Chapter teamed up with the Case Western Chapter to help with Recruitment and have a wonderful event of indoor Go Karting and Axe Throwing. The Go karts reach up to 55mph and saw Dan Russell as the first winner of Alumni Go Karting.

title: 2024 Annual Holiday Get Together
description: Another great Holiday Event. Alumni and Actives alike came together to celebrate the Holiday season at the Wild Eagle Saloon. The group exchanged white elephant gifts and showed the joys of Brotherhood.

title: BrewDog Doghouse Brotherhood Getaway
description: On Nov. 9th nine chapter members traveled to southeast Columbus to the Brewdog Brewhouse hotel for an overnight brotherhood. We got 1 suite and a few rooms and all hanging out with each other building on our already shared Brotherhood. We played classic video games, had dinner and took part in all the brewery had to offer. It was a great event to build our group together.

title: X-mas in July Happy Hour 2024
description: We had another great night of Brotherhood and we gathered at our favorite X-mas spot. Enjoyed catching up with old friends.

title: Guardians vs Mariners Baseball Game
description: Brothers and Families got out to the ballpark to celebrate Juneteeth and watch the Guardians take a win over the Mariners. Always a great time for the Brothers and their Families getting out to the ballpark

title: Tog Golf Outing
description: Members of the Chapter gathered to swing some clubs and have fun at Top Golf on May 18th. Followed by lunch in the Area. What a great event to meet up and have some fun!

title: 2024 Children's Hunger Alliance Charity Event
description: The Alumni Chapter once again partnered up with our support of the Children's Hunger Alliance in their fight for childhood hunger. Our Brothers donated items for auction and help raise money by attending their event in the flat on May 16th.

title: 2024 V Foundation Headshot Fundrasier
description: The Alumni Chapter hosted 2 Photo sessions at both Kent State and Case Western, where of "C" Doug Tayek took headshot photos as we raised $300 for the V Foundation.

title: 2024 Great Lakes Brewery Hop College
description: This past March members of the Alumni Chapter experienced a 2 hour private Hop College event at the Great Lakes Brewery. The College went through the history of Craft Brewing and Great Lakes. We got a private tour of the Brewery and got to sample some of the great beer from Great Lakes.

title: 2023 Annual Holiday Get Together
description: Again this year the Chapter got together to celebrate the holidays at the Wild Eagle Saloon. Some Brothers participated in a white elephant gift exchange with our "A" Michael Lippy getting a 3nd place cheerleader trophy as a gift.

title: 2023 Virtual Happy Hour
description: To get our virtual Brothers involved we hosted a November Happy Hour Mid November. We challenged each other with Trivia and shared great tales from the undergraduate years.

title: 2023 November Brewery Outing
description: After some rescheduling the Alumni Chapter held a get together at the Collison Bend Brewery on the West side of the Flats in Cleveland. We had some new faces come out and join us.

title: 2023 Founders Day Dinner
description: The Chapter hosted 15 area Alumni and 6 undergrads from Kent State and Case Western at Bricco in Kent, OH to celebrate the 133th Founders Day.

title: 2023 Summer Happy Hours
description: The 2023 was a wonderful 5 month events. We saw many different levels of attendance as we moved all around Northeast Ohio. It was a fun summer of great events. Tons of Brotherhood and connection.

title: Guardians vs. Brewers Ballgame
description: Brothers and there Families all came out to the Ballpark to watch our Cleveland Guardians beat the Milwaukee Brewers. Also got to take in a show from Walk the moon. See our Gallery for photos of all our events.

title: Spring Alumni Rededication Ceremony
description: This April we saw 2 more past Alumni go through the Delta Chi Alumni Rededication Ceremony at Kent State following the undergrad initiation. In our continued efforts to support our local Chapters. We held our 3rd Annual Night at the Ballpark to watch the Cleveland Indians take on the Chicago White Sox. This was a great night of fun with our Brothers from all over the area.

title: JAN. 21 2023 Akron Food Bank
description: 7 Members of the Chapter worked with the Akron-Canton Food Bank in Jan. Along with actives from the Kent State Chapter help with 21 hours of service helping sort meat. This Winter nearly 20 Brother got together to celebrate the holidays at the Wild Eagle Saloon in Broadview Hts. We shared an evening of Brotherhood and fun as we brought in the Holidays.

title: Oct. 15, 2022 Founders' Day Dinner
description: The Brothers got together to Celebrate our Founders' Day at R Shea Brewing in downtown Akron. See pictures in our Photo Gallery.

title: October 30th, 2021 Akron/Canton Beer Tour
description: Eight Members toured on a Chartered bus to 7 local breweries in the Akron/Canton Area. The tour was a great success. See pictures in our Photo Gallery.

title: Dec. 12th, 2019 Holiday Celebration Event
description: The Alumni Chapter Hosted it's 2nd Annual Holiday event at the Winking Lizard in Independence, OH

title: Alumni Rededication Ceremony
description: The Alumni Chapter hosted two Alumni Rededication Ceremonies at both Kent State and Case Western for Graduating Seniors. We welcomed 6 Brothers to this further and continuation of our Ritual.

title: Feb. 15 - 17, 2019: Region VI Regional Leader Conference (RLC)
description: The Northeast Ohio Alumni Chapter had the pleasure to host the 2019 Region VI RLC. The RLC was held at the Glenmoor Country Club in Canton, OH with a Brotherhood event at the Pro Football Hall of Fame. This is the first time Delta Chi History that an Alumni Chapters has hosted. See pictures in our Photo Gallery.

title: Meet and Greet Happy Hours
description: These were great events for Brothers to get together during the Holidays to hang out each other is a causal social event. See pictures in our Photo Gallery.

title: May 1, 2018: Indians vs Texas Ranger
description: The Northeast Ohio Alumni Chapter hosted it's second Night with the Indians. This was a great event seeing Alumni and undergrads from all over Northeast Ohio. See pictures in our photo gallery

title: October 13, 2017: Founder's Day Dinner
description: Our 2nd annual Northeast Ohio all Chapter Founder Day Dinner. Sponsered by the Northeast Ohio Alumni Chapter, featuring the Case Western Chapter and Kent State Colony. This year's event was at the Weymouth Country Club in Medina. See pictures in our photo gallery

title: May 16, 2017: A night at the ballpark
description: The Northeast Ohio Alumni Chapter sponsored a night to see your 2016 American League Champion Cleveland Indians take on the Tampa Bay Rays at Progressive Field. The event saw Alumni from five different Chapters and their families, came out to meet and enjoy Brotherhood!! See pictures in our photo gallery

title: October 13, 2016: Founder's Day Dinner
description: The Northeast Ohio Alumni Chapter, co-sponsored with the Case Western Reserve Chapter a celebration of our Founder's Day with a Dinner at Harry's Steakhouse in Independence, OH. This event mark the reformation of the Northeast Ohio Alumni Chapter. See pictures in our photo gallery
